title: Rate-free equidistribution of the nested floor-power tower (the qualitative K3 target)
statement: For each fixed depth d, the Juggler parity classes of length d have natural densities equal to their Bernoulli(1/2) values; equivalently (per depth) the floor-power tower ({n^{3/2}}, {v^{3/2}}, {z^{3/2}}, ...) with v = floor(n^{3/2}), z = floor(v^{3/2}) is jointly equidistributed in the limit, WITHOUT any rate. By the rate-free reduction (J-rate-free-density-one) this implies density-one finite descent; a node-wise biased form (every surviving class sends E-share >= beta > 1 - log2/log3 = 0.36907) suffices. The quantitative form (power savings, Conjecture K / Conjecture V / HH) is strictly stronger and is PARKED behind the BB/GG/JJ obstruction ladder; this record is the weakest hypothesis that still yields density one.
mathematical_domain: Juggler parity discrepancy / ergodic equidistribution of bracket-Hardy sequences
tested_range: dyadic window (10^6, 2*10^6]: 8x8x8 joint census of the depth-3 tower over 5*10^5 odd n, all 512 cells occupied, max cell deviation 0.145 of expectation vs extreme-value allowance 0.161; OOOO-conditioned fifth-letter even share 0.49835 (3-sigma band 0.0060); depth-4 split censuses of the two-step parity branch consistent through 2*10^6; nil-lift probe (dyadic (10^6, 2*10^6]): horizontal triple ((3/2)v^{3/4}, v^{3/2}, (1/2)v^{9/4}) mod 1 uniform, 124 fixed harmonics at square-root scale (max 2.11 sqrt N), Heisenberg vertical/abelian pair uniform; horizontal Weyl species probe: Taylor constants attained (3/32, 3/8, 45/32) through n=10^12; first-difference C/n^{15/8}->9/4 and C'/n^{7/8}->135/32 on 240 odd pairs, min C'=7.5e5; Hardy-entry lift of {v^{9/4}}: cubic remainder attains 15/128, |R3|<=1.1e-18 at n>=10^6, A2' leading 0.530 vs 135/256, Hardy pair ({n^{15/8}}, {n^{3/2}}) occupies 64/64 cells on 20000 odd starts in (4e4, 8e4]; PET re-entry: Fraction identity exact, A(n+2)-A(n)/n^{1/8} = 3.375 on 202 odd pairs in (10^4,10^4+200] and (10^6,10^6+200], leftover of ΔB vs smooth / n^{3/4} mean 0.42
counterexamples: none; a persistent cell deficit in the joint census or a fifth-letter share bounded away from [0.37, 0.63] on a positive-density subtree would refute
literature: Bergelson-Leibman generalized polynomials via nilmanifolds (polynomial brackets, arbitrary depth); Frantzikinakis 2009 (literature/frantzikinakis-2009-sparse-nilmanifolds.json: floor in the time slot of a fixed nilrotation); Richter 2023 (literature/richter-2023-hardy-nilmanifolds.json: Hardy-field times); Boshernitzan 1994 (literature/boshernitzan-1994-hardy-fields.json: circle Hardy unique ergodicity); Tsinas, Pointwise convergence in nilmanifolds along Hardy functions (2023); arXiv 2510.20562 (2025): twice-iterated Piatetski-Shapiro sequences by Kolesnik's method at SMALL amplitudes only. No published result covers nested floor-power brackets with Hardy (non-polynomial) entries: the door is the missing composition a^{f(floor(h(n)))} with f a nonlinear Hardy monomial (docs/problems/juggler_v94_rate_free.md, CLOSE). Host-Kra 2005 (literature/host-kra-2005-nilmanifolds.json) supplies the PET schema; the first difference of the Heisenberg lift re-expands into A{ΔB} (docs/problems/juggler_nil_pet_reentry.md, J-nil-pet-reentry). Broader audit (docs/problems/juggler_rate_free_floor_hardy.md, CLOSE): Tsinas 2023 (literature/tsinas-2023-pointwise-hardy-nilmanifolds.json) and Bergelson-Leibman 2007 (literature/bergelson-leibman-2007-generalized-polynomials.json) also miss; the β>β* fallback is a finite Weyl family of the same irreducible door.
notes: The tower observable expands by two-term Taylor (Lemma 7.2 of Paper B) into a finite-complexity bracket-Hardy expression: {z^{3/2}} = {v^{9/4} - (3/2) v^{3/4} {v^{3/2}} + o(1)}, so the target is exactly the Hardy-field extension of the Bergelson-Leibman bracket calculus, where brackets lift to nilmanifold coordinates instead of Fourier expansions. The BB/GG/JJ obstructions formally block rated (power-savings) methods only: BB kills differencing (W-family past 9/4), GG kills character windows (amplitude drift), JJ kills shift de-randomization; none of the three names an obstruction to rate-free ergodic identification. Falsifier for the route: the floor-removal correction term (3/2) v^{3/4} {v^{3/2}} may re-enter the amplitude-product class inside any candidate characteristic-factor argument, adding a fourth (ergodic) layer to the wall. No Paper B edit; the quantitative conjectures V and HH stay recorded and PARKED as-is. The Heisenberg lift does not reopen them: J-nil-lift-does-not-derandomize (1 Sep 2026) identifies the Proposition 7.4 shift with a Heisenberg y-translation and shows lambda=0 is a free center fiber, so JJ survives and the rated line stays PARKED.
